title: Concept: Referrer-Policy sends full URLs to cross-origin destinations
description: The Referrer-Policy value is no-referrer-when-downgrade. The browser sends the full URL, including path and query string, to cross-origin destinations that use an equal or stronger scheme, and strips it only when the destination is weaker. Third-party analytics, CDNs and linked sites therefore learn the exact page a user came from.
applicability: Responses that set Referrer-Policy, including framework defaults.
risk: Path and query-string disclosure to third parties; LOW severity because the leak is metadata rather than credentials.
